description: Change a schedule; only the fields you give change. Needs an administrator key. Set enabled to false to pause it and to true to resume it (resuming clears the failures that paused it). A new timetable counts from now.

cron.description: Five fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) or a descriptor such as @daily or @every 15m.

enabled.description: false pauses the schedule, true resumes it.

id.description: The schedule's id (sch_…), as returned by create_schedule or list_schedules.

input.description: Any JSON the agent receives as its input on every start (maximum 1 MiB).

max_cost_micros.description: Cost cap of each run, in millionths of a dollar.

skip_if_running.description: Skip a start while the previous run is still going.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid.

workflow.description: Name of the saved workflow to run.

name: update_schedule
title: Update or pause a schedule
